messages.subject: Michael | MENA Mining & Industrial Executive Profile | Government Relations, ESG & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Al-Nassir,

I am sharing my profile for senior Middle East and emerging-market leadership mandates across mining, industrials, energy-transition businesses and country-facing corporate functions.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio covers government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

Your regional leadership across the Middle East, Türkiye and Africa, together with extensive executive-search work in industrial and emerging markets, aligns closely with the mandates I am pursuing.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track roles spanning External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE.

I have attached a MENA-focused executive CV for confidential consideration. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
